title: False Floors: LLM Safety Routing Evaluations Break Under Distribution Shift
abstract: arXiv:2610.01535v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Safety routers send each request to one of several models and are judged against the best single model. A major routing benchmark picks that comparator on the evaluation data. In the benchmark's own setting this is harmless, but under distribution shift it is not. On HELM Safety the selection cost is 0.003-0.030 of harm under random splits and 0.045-0.113 under held-out categories, comparable to the whole deficit attributed to routing, with its direction holding under either published judge alone. It rises seven- to ninefold on AgentDojo when suites are held out. Across seven safety corpora chosen by rules fixed in advance, three meet a registered interval test and four beat a later permutation null, and three of the four interval misses are corpora where some models have zero observed harm. translated_title: 虚假底线：大语言模型安全路由评估在分布偏移下失效
translated_abstract: 安全路由器将每个请求分发给多个模型中的一个，并以最佳单一模型作为基准进行评判。一个主要的路由基准测试是在评估数据上选取该比较对象的。在基准测试自身的设置下这是无害的，但在分布偏移下则不然。在HELM Safety上，随机划分下选择成本为危害值的0.003-0.030，而在留出类别下为0.045-0.113，这与归因于路由的全部缺陷相当，且其方向在单独使用任一已发布的评判者时均保持一致。当测试套件被留出时，该成本在AgentDojo上上升七到九倍。在按预先固定规则选择的七个安全语料库中，三个通过了预注册的区间检验，四个击败了后续的置换零假设，而四个区间检验未通过的语料库中有三个是某些模型的观测危害为零的语料库。先前的工作已证明该偏差的方向。我们在危害和准确性两方面对其进行了量化，表明在我们所测量的留出划分下该偏差更大……
tldr: 论文量化了LLM安全路由评估中的基准选择偏差：该偏差在分布内无害，但在留出类别或套件等分布偏移下会增长到与归因于路由的整个缺陷相当、甚至放大七到九倍的程度，从而导致路由评估结论失效。
en_tdlr: This paper quantifies a comparator-selection bias in LLM safety routing evaluations—harmless in-distribution but growing to match the entire attributed routing deficit and rising seven- to ninefold on AgentDojo under distribution shift—showing that such evaluations break under held-out splits.
